_readme.1: Origins allowed to call the API and read from S3.
_readme.2: Used in THREE places by lib/infra-cdk-stack.ts: API Gateway CORS, the S3 bucket CORS rule, and the S3 bucket-policy aws:Referer condition.
_readme.3: Add a new domain under any group. Group names are free-form.
_readme.4: Every array in this file is merged, so you can add new groups without touching the stack code.
_readme.5: Origins must NOT have a trailing slash.
_readme.6: Redeploy the CDK stack for changes to take effect.
